scope: credential-free local backup creation and isolated restore validation
claims: Invite and collaborative-document tenant ownership must match the referenced team.
API keys and usage reservations must remain owned by the account and subscription they reference.
Usage ledger and refund records must preserve the ownership chain of their reservation and usage entry.
Ownership drift is rejected before backup or restore atomic promotion.
limitations: No staging or production restore was performed.
No provider, payment, credential, signing, retention, deployment or publication action was performed.
Independent review and externally retained rollback evidence remain separately gated.
